question: Compare our suppliers — who is the most reliable?
agent_answer:
Here's the full supplier comparison (source: SRM):

| Supplier | ID | Rating | On-Time Rate | Avg Lead (days) | Declared Lead | Total POs |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Somchai Mango Farm | SUP-001 | 4.5 | **100%** (13/13) | 2.9 | 3 | 14 |
| Rayong Tropical | SUP-004 | 4.0 | **100%** (6/6) | 2.8 | 3 | 7 |
| Isaan Organic Farms | SUP-005 | 3.5 | 33% (3/9) | 7.1 | 6 | 10 |
| Prachuap Harvest | SUP-003 | 2.8 | 25% (2/8) | 5.1 | 4 | 10 |
| Northern Fruits Co. | SUP-002 | 3.2 | 24% (4/17) | 6.3 | 5 | 19 |

**Winner: Somchai Mango Farm (SUP-001)** — perfect on-time rate across 14 orders (the largest sample), actual lead time matches declared (2.9 vs 3 days), and the highest rating of 4.5. Rayong Tropical (SUP-004) is equally reliable but has only 7 orders, making the track record thinner.

**Red flags:** Northern Fruits Co. (SUP-002) has the worst on-time rate (24%) despite the most orders — their chronic lateness is well-documented. Prachuap Harvest (SUP-003) and Isaan Organic Farms (SUP-005) also significantly exceed their declared lead times in practice.
